research_question: Does low-learning-rate planning fine-tuning of a NAVSIM-adapted LPWM produce particles useful for trajectory planning while preserving visual dynamics?
precision: FP32 official image encoder, BF16 dynamics/planner, activation checkpointing
schedule: linear warmup 1 percent updates, cosine decay to 10 percent initial LR
planner_input: four observed RGB frames, current 8D ego status, causal eight-step LPWM prior rollout
encoder_conditioning: zero-initialized bounded FiLM from current four-dimensional driving command inside particle attribute CNN
planning_loss: soft expert trajectory classification + six NAVSIM-v1 simulator subscore BCE terms; world ELBO retained except metric_only
world_loss: unchanged official stage1 temporal ELBO on independently sampled training clips, never future input to planner
data: all eligible observed-input navtrain training records, same recording validation split as stage1; no fixed clip cap
checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch, epoch diagnostics do not select the best development checkpoint
evaluation: full development ADE/FDE and all eligible official PDM; validate each condition before the next; locked full navtest after development gates

DrivoR.use: compact perception memory and trajectory-conditioned subscore decoder; our fixed vocabulary replaces continuous proposal generation

DriveSuprim.use: reviewed candidate imitation and metric distillation; coarse-to-fine selection and camera augmentation deferred

Hydra-MDP.use: train-only trajectory vocabulary and privileged simulator metric distillation; official implementation unavailable at review

Drive-JEPA.use: reviewed safe multimodal trajectory supervision; full PF checkpoint remains an unchanged evaluation reference

SafeDrive_workspace.use: read-only reference: candidate refinement, scene safety and temporal drivable supervision, live rescoring of refined trajectories; no BEV-coordinate or object-identity assumptions transferred

refinement.shortlist: 16 predicted metric-ranked + 16 predicted imitation-ranked; no GT selection in forward
refinement.online_teacher: actual detached refined trajectories; unchanged official PDM simulator/scorer with pairwise reference normalization
refinement.extra_objective: nearest refined expert smoothL1 XY + 0.5 circular heading + six refined subscore BCE + 0.5 two temporal safety BCE + 0.01 differentiable acceleration/jerk excess
refinement.temporal_targets: prefix no-at-fault collision and prefix drivable compliance at 0.5,...,4.0 s

deferred_comparison: world-objective-off comparison is deferred in favor of the newly requested future-particle candidate refinement comparison; no completed run is changed
